rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to give the gist or an overview.

example.english: Please outline it first so everyone can follow more easily.
example.traditional: 請你先講個大概，等大家容易跟進。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 sin1 gong2 go3 daai6 koi3 dang2 daai6 gaa1 jung4 ji6 gan1 zeon3

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate, compact summary, especially of a text or topic.

example.english: I use a few sentences to outline the content of the article.
example.traditional: 我用幾句說話概括篇文章嘅內容。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 gei2 geoi3 syut3 waa6 koi3 kut3 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 noi6 jung4

rows.note: Use 大綱 for the broad structure of a subject or a preliminary project or speech plan, rather than for a finished summary.

example.english: This outline makes clear how the whole plan will be carried out.
example.traditional: 呢份大綱講清楚成個計劃點做。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 daai6 gong1 gong2 cing1 co2 seng4 go3 gai3 waak6 dim2 zou6

rows.note: Use 輪廓 as the all-purpose choice for the boundary line or outer shape of an object or figure.

example.english: Draw an outline first, and add the details later.
example.traditional: 你先畫個輪廓，細節遲啲先加。
example.jyutping: nei5 sin1 waa2 go3 leon4 kwok3 sai3 zit3 ci4 di1 sin1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the focus is describing something rather than summarizing a whole text.

example.english: I outline the new plan for everyone.
example.traditional: 我向大家描述個新方案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hoeng3 daai6 gaa1 miu4 seot6 go3 san1 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically when physically drawing the outline or contours of something.

example.english: I outline it in pencil first, then slowly fill in the colours.
example.traditional: 我用鉛筆畫出輪廓先，再慢慢填色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 jyun4 bat1 waa6 ceot1 leon4 gwok3 sin1 zoi3 maan6 maan6 tin4 sik1

rows.note: Use 摘要 when the outline is a condensed statement of a text's important points.

example.english: The outline of this article clearly lists the key points.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅摘要清楚咁列出重點。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 zaak6 jiu3 cing1 co2 gam2 lit6 ceot1 zung6 dim2

rows.note: Use 線稿 for an artwork or sketch made with contour lines and little or no shading.

example.english: I’m drawing the outline of the picture and haven’t coloured it yet.
example.traditional: 我畫緊幅畫嘅線稿，仲未上色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waa2 gan2 fuk1 waa2 ge3 sin3 gou2 zung6 mei6 soeng5 sik1
